profileSections.heading: Teaching and complex dermatology
profileSections.text: UCSF Health describes medical-student teaching as part of Berger's work and says he was inducted into its Academy of Medical Educators for that dedication. UCSF Medical Education records him as a Dermatology member of the academy from 2003 to 2015; the UCSF Health profile also reports that dermatology residents named him Teacher of the Year in 1991 and 2001. These are source-stated career details, not evidence of current teaching duties or patient outcomes.

profileSections.heading: Before requesting care
profileSections.text: UCSF Health says Berger sees patients only by referral or in the UCSF Executive Health Practice. Its page lists Dermatology Mount Zion at 1701 Divisadero Street, San Francisco, CA 94115, phone 415-353-7800, and telehealth visits. Current appointment availability, Executive Health eligibility, fees, and plan participation are not established by this listing; confirm directly with UCSF.
